title: Interactive approval guard
summary: Interactive sessions run with a guarded approval mode.

protected.failure: Interactive sessions approve consequential actions automatically.

rationale: Superseded: guarding only the interactive mode leaves unattended session modes outside the policy. Retained for reference; profiles resolve this control to its successor.

variants.description: Set the interactive approval mode to a guarded value and read it back.

verification.method: Read the interactive approval mode back per home.
verification.evidence: Mode name and value per home.

failure_modes: Unattended session modes remain open, which is the gap that motivated supersession.
